_comments.device_name: Substring to match your USB mic name. Use --list-devices to find it. Examples: 'usb microphone', 'Headset Microphone'
_comments.action: The action to execute. Examples below.
_comments.key_codes: 113 = KEY_MUTE, 248 = KEY_MICMUTE, 190 = KEY_F20. Use --monitor to find your button's code.
_comments.grab_device: true = block original mute event, false = keep original mute AND trigger action
_comments.auto_reconnect: true = automatically reconnect if USB device is disconnected/reconnected
